title: USB device: CDC, HID, MSC, and custom classes

questions.prompt: Which option states the main idea of “USB device: CDC, HID, MSC, and custom classes” correctly?
options: USB is more than power and a Serial Monitor cable.
A USB host enumerates peripherals, supplies bus power, and communicates through class drivers.
A USB device is the peripheral connected to a computer.
USB CDC provides a serial console, MSC exposes block storage to a host, and USB MIDI sends musical control events to a computer.
questions.answer: A USB device is the peripheral connected to a computer.
questions.explanation: A USB device is the peripheral connected to a computer.

questions.prompt: Which additional fact about “USB device: CDC, HID, MSC, and custom classes” is accurate?

USB CDC creates a virtual COM port
ESP32-S2/S3 OTG boards can support keyboards, mice, CDC adapters, and MSC drives.

questions.explanation: Boards with USB peripheral hardware, such as ESP32-S2/S3, can expose serial, keyboard, storage, or a custom interface.
